description: This Java class handles the creation of tax components within the Fineract system. It is a command handler that processes commands to create new tax components, delegating the actual creation logic to a service class.

classes.name: CreateTaxComponentCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to create tax components. It implements NewCommandSourceHandler and delegates the creation process to TaxWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a tax component by invoking the service layer.
